name: fly-browser
description: A small, minimal Linux browser with full keyboard control and a polished experience for mouse users.

scripts.test: node tests/auth-security.test.js && node tests/adblocker-startup.test.js && node tests/adblocker-build.test.js && node tests/clock.test.js && node tests/audio-controls.test.js && node tests/pinned-tabs.test.js && node tests/notes-reader-export.test.js && node tests/search-aliases.test.js && node tests/config-writes.test.js && node tests/profile-migration.test.js && node tests/keyboard.test.js && node scripts/sync-keyboard.js --check && node scripts/generate-keybind-docs.js --check && node tests/navigation-focus.test.js && node tests/overlay-state.test.js && node tests/extensions.test.js && node tests/tab-jump.test.js && node tests/focus-recovery.test.js
scripts.install-desktop: mkdir -p ~/.local/share/applications ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/{48x48,128x128,256x256}/apps && cp fly-browser.desktop ~/.local/share/applications/ && cp assets/icons/fly-logo48.png ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/48x48/apps/fly-browser.png && cp assets/icons/fly-logo128.png ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/128x128/apps/fly-browser.png && cp assets/icons/fly-logo256.png ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/fly-browser.png && update-desktop-database ~/.local/share/applications && gtk-update-icon-cache -f -t ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor
scripts.test:keyboard-ui: node tests/keyboard-ui.test.js && node tests/navigation-focus-ui.test.js && node tests/overlay-state-ui.test.js && node tests/sidebar-pointer-focus-ui.test.js && node tests/settings-nav-ui.test.js && node tests/tab-close-typing-ui.test.js && node tests/sidebar-cursor-ui.test.js && node tests/legacy-keybinds-ui.test.js
